hook:
A badge with three screens.
Press A, B, C.

roles.badger-2350: E-paper badge, buttons and case lights

igCaption: The Pimoroni Badger 2350 boots into an e-paper badge on a 264x176 SSD1680 panel. Button A shows the badge, B reads the PCF85063A clock, C shows battery and USB info. UP and DOWN switch the rear case lights on and off. It all runs on an RP2350 emulator in your browser.
ytTitle: Pimoroni Badger 2350 e-paper badge in the browser #shorts
ytDescription: The Badger 2350 draws a name badge on its 2.7 inch e-paper, with A/B/C switching between badge, RTC clock and info screens. UP and DOWN toggle the rear case lights. Open it in your browser: https://velxio.dev/example/badger-2350-badge
